name: SampleAccountabilityReconciler
tagline: Every drug sample unit traced from shipment to signed HCP request – in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete pharmaceutical sample accountability app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: acknowledge shipments, record disbursements with HCP signatures and licence checks, transfer and return samples, reconcile rep inventory by product and lot against physical counts, investigate discrepancies and track FDA loss/theft reporting deadlines. Works instantly in demo mode.
features: Signed-request and state-licence checks for every disbursement
Per-request and annual per-HCP unit limits
Shipment receipt acknowledgement with shortage discrepancies
Rep inventory reconciliation by product and lot with in-transit units
Witnessed physical counts with variance tolerance
Discrepancy investigation, root cause and inventory adjustments
Significant loss/theft FDA deadline in working days
Signature compliance per rep and annual inventory due
Audit pack CSV exports, undo, history, read-only mode, phone layout
controlType: standard (2 controls: SampleAccountabilityReconciler data-set + SampleAccountabilityReconcilerPortal field control for Power Pages)
